rules.title: No panic on input the model produced
rules.text: The exit-code contract has one failure code, `1`, with the reason on stderr. A panic is `101`: a code the contract does not define and a failure a script cannot branch on. A missing JSON field, a malformed stream chunk or an absent choice is a normal failure of a model, not an invariant violation.

judgement.question: Is this unwrap or expect reachable on input the model or the server produced — a missing JSON field, a malformed stream chunk, an absent choice — so that a failure panics instead of returning the contract's exit 1 with a reason?

criteria.true: the value can be absent or malformed in a response, so a bad answer panics the process
criteria.false: it is in test code, or behind an invariant that makes the value infallible at this point (a value just checked, a constant, a literal)
